cd /workspace && cat > dev/test_perf3.py <<'PYEOF'
import random, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import importlib.util
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('m','/workspace/submission/main.py')
m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m)

def mk(rng,nflows,nnodes,capmin,capmax,minlen,maxlen,cval,counts=None,pin=0):
    nodes=['v%02d'%i for i in range(nnodes)]
    caps=dict((n,rng.randint(capmin,capmax)) for n in nodes)
    flows=[];offers={}
    H=8
    for i in range(nflows):
        k=rng.randint(minlen,min(maxlen,nnodes))
        path=rng.sample(nodes,k)
        fid='f%02d'%i
        kinds='KKKDZQTK'
        tmpl=bytes([i&255,2,3,4,5,6,7,8])
        flows.append(dict(id=fid,path=path,template=tmpl.hex(),kinds=kinds))
        hdr=bytearray(tmpl); hdr[3]=rng.randint(0,255); hdr[5]=rng.randint(0,7); hdr[6]=k+rng.randint(1,3)
        cnt = rng.randint(1,cval) if counts is None else counts[i%len(counts)]
        offers[fid]=[dict(header=bytes(hdr).hex(),count=cnt)]
    ids=[f['id'] for f in flows]
    return dict(mode='plan',capacities=caps,flows=flows,warmup=0,pinned=rng.sample(ids,pin) if pin else [],offers=offers)

rng=random.Random(5)
worst=(0,None)
for trial in range(400):
    style=trial%8
    if style==0: req=mk(rng,22,1,1,11,1,1,50)            # single node knapsack cap 11
    elif style==1: req=mk(rng,22,2,1,1,1,2,1)             # 2 nodes, cap 1 each, equal values
    elif style==2: req=mk(rng,22,22,1,1,2,3,7)           # 22 nodes cap1, paths 2-3 => matching/packing
    elif style==3: req=mk(rng,22,6,2,2,3,3,3)            # 3-uniform-ish packing cap2
    elif style==4: req=mk(rng,22,4,1,2,2,4,100)
    elif style==5: req=mk(rng,22,2,1,1,2,2,1,counts=[1,2,3,5,8])  # additive ties
    elif style==6: req=mk(rng,22,8,1,3,2,5,1000,pin=3)
    else: req=mk(rng,22,16,1,2,2,6,2,counts=[3,6,9,12,15,18])
    st=time.time(); got=m.respond(req); el=time.time()-st
    if el>worst[0]: worst=(el,style,trial)
    if el>2: print('SLOW',style,trial,el, str(got)[:80])
print('worst %.3f s at style %s trial %s'%worst)
PYEOF
